BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Ferzen the Rock Dragon!!
Aye?! What's that monster?!\nAlso that face on the tree is moving!!\nWhy? Why?!
You don't know what the monster and the giant tree\nare fighting about. But the tree clearly seems to\nbe in an unfavorable situation...
Bwahaha! What are you gonna do now?!\nThose veggies that usually protect you are not\nhere!!
Shut up! They're Sapiens, not veggies!\nNot only Sapiens, but all creatures in the forest\nsuffer because of you and your barbaric behavior!!
Today I'll be their shield.\nI'll protect them from you, evil dragon!!
Ugh!!
The fact that you can't move is already your\ndefeat. Don't worry, after I chop you down, I'll\nget rid of all those annoying veggies too!
Oh gosh, this is bad!\nThat tree guy is gonna get chopped down!!
Did you freaking call your friend? Um?\nYou're...not this tree's friend, are you?\nUm? I see, aren't you a human?
It's been so long since I last saw a human in\nthis world...\nWhy are you interrupting?!
Are you a Lixi?!
Y-you...who are you...H-how dare you fool me...\nw-with that weak-looking appearance of yours...\nUgh...
Thank you for saving me. I'm the guardian of the\nforest around here, my name is Arbol...
Thank you for saving me. I'm the guardian of the\nforest around here, my name is Arbol...\nUghh!!
Aye?! Are you okay? You're full of wounds.
I wish I could say that this is nothing, but...\nIt really got me...
I wish I could watch over the young ones a little\nbit longer, but...\nI guess it's over for me now...
Aye~! Aren't there any medicines that can treat\nyour wounds?! If yes, we're gonna go get them for\nyou!!
There is but perhaps it's impossible for you to\nget it...
It's the horn of a beast that is ground into\npowder, but the beast is way bigger than you...
What?! You have it?! Ooh...!!\nD-does that mean you beat that monster?!
...O-okay, we can make the medicine by grinding\nthe horn and mixing it with water into a paste.\nBut to heal all these wounds, we need more horns.
You're lucky that you managed to beat one and get\nits horn although you're not Eumano soldiers.
So, how many do we need?
It'd be enough if we have 20 horns...But, wait!\nDon't tell me you guys are seriously gonna go\ncollect them?
Stop it! I can't let two young lives make the\nsacrifice for a decrepit old thing like me!!
Aye! It's okay!! Just leave it to us!
What? So you've encountered that monster before...\nOkay. The medicine is made by grinding its horn\nand mixing it with water into a paste...
But to heal all these wounds, you need to beat\nquite many of them. Even a Eumano soldier says\nit's hard, and you don't look powerful either...
How many do we need?
It'd be enough if we have 20 horns...But, wait!\nDon't tell me you guys are seriously gonna go\ncollect them?
Stop it! As I said, it's difficult even for a\nEumano soldier to defeat one.
I can't let two young lives make the sacrifice for\na decrepit old thing like me!!
Aye! It's okay!! Just leave it to us!
Aye, we've got them. What do we with them again?\nDo we crush them?
W-wow, you guys really got them...U-um, grind them\nand mix them with water into a paste to make the\nmedicine. Can I ask you to do that one last task?
Aye, easy, easy!
Aye, easy, easy! Hey, I can count on you, right?
Okay, alright...Is this okay?
Yeah, I'm very much in your debt...The wounds will\nheal in no time. I can't believe you went this far\nfor me although we just met for the first time...
I feel so bad that I can't thank you properly, but\nplease, take this...
You got "Dryad Jewel" from Giant Arbol.
Umm...I thought I mistook you for a Lixi, but now\nI really think you are. Besides, you...don't seem\nto be a Eumano either...Who are you exactly...?
So sus! Who the hey are you?!
They seem to belong to the same race as the\nfigures you have seen many times along the way...
Folium!! Hold on everyone! These guys protected\nme from the dragon. Keep your weapons!!
B-but...
T-that's Dryad Jewel!!
That's the proof of courage that Arbol only gives\nto those whose courage he recognizes...\nWhoa, whoa!!
I'm sorry. My name is Folium. On behalf of\neveryone, I'd like to thank you for saving our\nancestree from the barbaric dragon...
What? This tree is your ancestree?!\n...By the way, what's an ancestree?
Please forgive me for fooling and making you go\naround in circles...
We're Eumanos. The Sapiens living in this forest.\nAnd Arbol is the guardian of the town Eumanos\nlive in.
An old Eumano becomes a tree serving as a shield\nto protect the town by attaching its roots to the\nground...But it can no longer move elsewhere...
Lixi!!
Wait, this guy has also helped me.\nHe is not dangerous.
Aye? Eh? What?? What is it?\nWhat did you guys say I was?!
...What's going on here? Lixis usually attack us\nas soon as they find us...
Hey, that's so mean! You make me sound like a\nmonster!!
Is he your companion...? Also from your world...?\nHe doesn't have that evil aura...So he's similar\nbut different from the Lixi that we know.
Anyway...Are you guys...Sapiens?\nYou don't look like us Eumanos, nor do you look\nlike Ranas though...
Eumano, Rana...Those names were among the many\nwords you heard when you first got here...
They sound like the names of the races living in\nthis world...
They sound like the names of the races living in\nthis world...\nBut, why did he say "you guys"?
Ohh, actually a few days ago, an airship with a\nfew passengers crashed into a nearby forest.
Those passengers look quite similar to you so I\nthought they could be your friends, that's why I\nsaid "you guys"...
I see, so they're your friends indeed.\nThey're in the town now. I'll take you to them.\nFollow me...
Guys, he looks like a Lixi, but he seems to be\ndifferent from them. I'll escort them to the town\nand take responsibility for it. Any objections?
If anyone is against it, speak up!\nI'll include it when I report to our leader.
I think it's fine. Even though he looks like a\nLixi, we can not deny the fact that he saved\nArbol...
The residents of the town are going to take good\ncare of you.\nJust make yourselves comfortable...
I'm not very happy with what they were saying\nabout me...*mumbling*
